ordered_step_reconstruction: For the fixed-mu logarithmic q-field, the exact relative recurrence gives w_i-w_(i-1)=-a_i d_i, d_(i+1)-d_i=K_iw_i, w_0=0, d_1=-1, and L_+W=(w_m/a_m)e_last with every a_i>0.

L_+ is positive definite with strictly negative path off-diagonals, hence an irreducible symmetric Z-matrix. Writing L_+=sI-B with B nonnegative and rho(B)<s proves L_+^(-1)>=0 by the Neumann series; path irreducibility makes every inverse entry strictly positive. The max continuant gives w_m=(product a_i)det(L_+)>0, so every internal w_i>0.

Define C_0=q^2-1 and chi(theta)=C_0 sin(theta)/(sin(theta)+mu sin(mu theta)). On 0<theta<pi/mu, 0<chi<C_0 and chi is strictly increasing because cot(theta)-mu cot(mu theta)>0. Strict R8 phase alternation therefore gives sign Delta_i=sign gamma_i and Delta_i/gamma_i>0.

With Y_i=-(V_t^2+mu^2 rho_iV^2) and H_i=Y_i+chi_i, the common energy gives H_i<0 and Y_i+chi_(i-1)<0. Define N_i=gamma_iw_i-d_iH_i. Exact cell transfer makes this flux endpoint invariant and exact saltation cancellation gives N_i-N_(i-1)=d_iDelta_i.

The left endpoint values Y_0=-q^2, w_0=0, d_1=-1 yield N_1=-q^2+chi_1<-1. Eliminating d_i gives N_i(1+Delta_i/H_i)=N_(i-1)+gamma_iw_iDelta_i/H_i. The divisor equals (Y_i+chi_(i-1))/(Y_i+chi_i)>0 and the added source is strictly negative, so induction proves N_i<0 on every internal cell.

Differentiating each simple event gives dot(t_i)=-d_i/gamma_i. Combining the q-field and time-translation recurrences yields dot(theta_i)=-sqrt(rho_i)K_iN_i/(gamma_i gamma_(i+1)). Consecutive gamma values have opposite sign, so sign dot(theta_i)=-sign K_i: positive max cells contract and negative max cells expand.

For k=sin(theta)sin(mu theta)/(1+cos(theta)cos(mu theta)), the identity (1+cos(theta)cos(mu theta))^2-(sin(theta)sin(mu theta))^2=(cos(theta)+cos(mu theta))^2 and strict phase separation give 0<k<1. Thus alpha=atanh(k) is finite and partial_theta alpha=[sin(mu theta)+mu sin(theta)]/[cos(theta)+cos(mu theta)], whose sign is sign K_i. Hence dot(alpha_i)<0 and, since q>1, partial_q alpha_i<0.

No step uses a fixed-q mu field, common-terminal dq/dmu feedback, a norm derivative, a full residual Jacobian, reflection, uniqueness, or O3a. Those quantities are neither concluded nor silently placed in the trusted closure.
